en_US.title: Ran/Aegir Distance Band
en_US.scanner: Public band: Ran/Aegir is a 10.5 ly no-FTL route from Sol.
en_US.terminal: EPHEMERIS BAND. Use 10.5 ly class until celestial constants freeze. No FTL rescue.
en_US.audio: Ten light-years is close on a map and brutal for a contract.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Ran/Aegir remains a hard-sci-fi near-star target. The player-facing value is a distance band, not final simulation ephemeris.

en_US.field_note: Use for site astronomy primer and codex route map. Do not claim final ephemeris constants.

en_US.title: Aegir Window Bands
en_US.scanner: Local band: ascent waits on hours-to-days windows, not instant rescue.
en_US.terminal: WINDOW BAND. Shutter, eclipse, relay, storm, carrier phase and legal handshake must align.
en_US.audio: The carrier can hear you and still be in the wrong sky.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Local windows turn orbital mechanics into gameplay pressure. A repaired capsule still needs timing, relay and weather permission.
en_US.external_site: Aegir's local traffic is governed by narrow transfer bands around radiation, eclipse and relay geometry.
en_US.field_note: Use for Black Keel timing UI, in-game wiki and spoiler-light site systems page.

ru_RU.title: Окна Aegir

ru_RU.audio: Carrier может тебя слышать и все равно быть не в том небе.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Локальные окна превращают орбитальную механику в игровое давление. Даже починенной капсуле нужны timing, relay и weather permission.
